title: Research: streamed R437 leaf/XOR ownership under the canonical caller's installed pool
body:
## Change and mathematical scope

Adds `research/r437-canonical-workspace/`, a source-bound **partial construction with a successful-input ownership lemma**. It is not a complete caller admission.

PR #5187's standalone workspace cannot be placed directly inside `Machine.run`'s persistent pool installation: it allocates a raw output Tape while the caller forbids physical constructors. Its per-prefix empty-pool check also cannot be kept unchanged once the producer's five Count leases live in that pool. Both are interface mismatches, not counterexamples to #5187's standalone theorem.

The adapter runs the unchanged PR #5055 producer/consumer code objects on one already installed caller pool plus four supplied persistent roles (full output, saved prefix, current prefix, reader). It preserves the five producer lease identities at every prefix, retires every consumer and producer lease by macro return, executes the original `Machine.commit`, and explicitly clears the returned raw output, which `Machine.commit` does not retire. It preserves arbitrary dirty payload semantics under the predecessor's closed, synchronous leaf contract.

What is established, and on what it rests:

- **Conditional reserve.** A pool of **q²+141 scratch tapes** suffices: #5187's inherited consumer bound q²+136 plus the five producer leases. This is conditional on #5187's source lifetime bound, which is not re-proved here. It is 13 more scratch tapes than the original Machine constructor's q²+128. The pool backing bound includes the producer's `bit_length(N)` term.
- **Exact commit tariff.** For returned length n and prior destination length t, literal commit plus source retirement costs `(reads, writes, moves) = (2t+7n+10, t+2n, 2t+6n+14)`.
- **Finite pricing.** The complete q3/w2/d2 fixture pays exactly **403,060 additional record-cell actions** before commit; numerical Word traffic is unchanged.

**Open obligations.** Actual dispatch must still supply the four persistent roles and the 13 extra scratch roles over the unchanged constructor, or prove a tighter reserve. No full node, admitted root or recursive return is executed. The CALL method is tested only at its early live-lease rejection guard; the complete commit method is executed. Node/root/CALL/RETURN scheduling, source Program binding, parking and terminal-marker ownership, all-parameter source traffic T, Context/codebook, precision/stock, native/compiler/ordinary/outer admission and fixed-control lowering remain open. No new κ, scalar-word change, paid-histogram change or selected-frontier change is claimed. The carrier's added ADDs remain charged.

## Task and overlap

- Task `r437-carrier-integration`, priority revision 7; scope key `824b1dd88287a1bb4229/canonical-installed-pool-streamed-leaf-ownership`; scope **refined** to one physical-caller allocation/commit implication. Full task card: [TASK.json](research/r437-canonical-workspace/TASK.json).
- Head `d442584322f1457228009c6dbd7e7c082fac3b27` on base main `32890bc5de034ab8fc93ac88ead7279a6a416d04`. Canonical main was fetched again at 05:43 and 05:55 UTC on 2026-10-25 and was unchanged.
- Exact predecessors: PR #5187 `f7c4d65b11e658fa093f0bac9f5f4b8ca346a4b8`; PR #5055 final package source `08a8be5e1387156446394694f768937d15f0e1ba` (producer code introduced at `a1e94f68a448a98ea4168240dff611dd551f1f90`); physical caller/pool source `61f4d7ce898fcb64e89c55519f5b3a340e8e7368`. All 418 live inputs are Git-blob/SHA256-pinned at the base in SOURCES.json; there is no dependency on an unmerged head.
- Claim: [Discussion #4682, comment 19173695](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4682#discussioncomment-19173695), taking [PR #5187's explicit handoff](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/discussions/4682#discussioncomment-19144606).
- Nearest overlap: [#5187](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5187) proves standalone workspace reuse; [#5055](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/5055) supplies complete streaming and [#4981](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/4981) supplies prefix fusion. This package adds their installed-caller allocation/commit boundary. #5107's G/S/R tariff and #4927's directory-reserve audit concern other intervals. This account's #3223 NODE/peel/return audit is not repeated. #4067's exchange and #4147's reverse coefficient remain predecessors and are not rederived.
- Bounded domain and method: source-relative induction over all successful prefixes under the stated callback/lifetime premises; the complete q3/w2/d2 fixture; exact tape and Word counters; the predecessor's independent payload oracle; literal commit calibration for 0<=n,t<=16. The scope was narrowed to this interface, with no search expansion.
- Overlap check: the task-card search, then `r437-streamed-leaf-workspace`, `nested pool`, `canonical ownership`, `caller allocator` and workspace/Machine text across all packages on main. All 371 open PR bodies, including drafts, at 05:31 UTC and 4,779 Discussion records at 05:33 UTC on 2026-10-25, both with complete pagination, plus every package note on main and the PR ledger. A snapshot of PR bodies and Discussions does not cover arbitrary diffs or unpublished work and is not a novelty guarantee.
- No guidance, priority, selected-record or source change since the base. The selected record resolves to #5413, although older selection text in the priority table names an earlier record; it is unchanged.

## Validation

Python 3.12.3, standard library, serial execution. All of these pass:

```sh
python3 -B scripts/research_selected_baseline.py
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/r437-canonical-workspace --check-only
python3 -B scripts/research_package.py --package research/r437-canonical-workspace
python3 -B scripts/check_research_commit.py --package research/r437-canonical-workspace --check-source-history
```

The selected baseline is bindings-only orientation. The package runner prints `PASS_R437_CANONICAL_WORKSPACE` in ordinary and optimized modes (about 35 seconds each), followed by `PASS_REGISTERED_RESEARCH_PACKAGE research/r437-canonical-workspace outcome=partial`.

Evidence: all **243** physical prefixes (including duplicates), **19,683** dirty payload bits, **1,458** coefficient calls, **261,492** uniquely retired leases and every producer-state boundary pass. Original eager execution and the independent permutation/XOR oracle agree. The original seven fixture controls remain. Eleven new controls reject aliasing, dirty, under-reserved and uninstalled pools, live CALL state, a premature global empty, omitted retirement and same-slot producer replacement. The harness changes one module binding and deletes no predecessor checks. Three failure-only callback runs use a separate checker counter while keeping the same coefficient code and other closure values.

All **289** literal commit/retirement cases match the exact formula. A separate whole-fixture source comparison measures **45,830,745 → 46,233,805** record-cell actions, which attains the derived +403,060 surcharge `K + 4(A−5)N + 4A + 28` with K = 261,492 leases, A = 150 tapes and N = 243 prefixes. Index and residue Word traffic vectors are identical. This is finite pricing, not a global saving or a universal formula for T.

The committed-byte/source-history preflight covers **427** files. The official committed exporter and integrity checker pass. A fresh Git-free export with an empty executable PATH and read-only files and directories passes the direct normal and optimized commands in **34.171 s / 34.450 s**; every exported byte remains unchanged. Export SHA256: `d273b5e5bc217847c32f615e27424134f81ab4ef9d507cef9c84e06621bf81f4`.

```sh
python3 -I -W error -B research/r437-canonical-workspace/verify.py
python3 -I -W error -O -B research/r437-canonical-workspace/verify.py
```

Not run: the dimension-64 SOURCE87 calibration, the full high-domain or original q127 payload, a complete node/CALL/RETURN, native/ordinary/outer replay, Lean, and independent human or formal-kernel review. The inherited source lifetime theorem is not independently re-proved. Rollback after an arbitrary exception is not claimed.

## Open next questions

[README.md](research/r437-canonical-workspace/README.md#open-next-questions) and TASK.json name two bounded follow-ups:

1. Choose one actual R437 dispatch interval, prove that the four persistent roles are available, supply the 13 additional scratch roles or prove a tighter reserve, and join the source Program, producer, leaf, destination, parking and terminal-marker lifetimes. The missing schedule and role availability prevent whole-caller admission.
2. Derive the unchanged source traffic T for one actual coefficient history and closed leaf, then compose producer, pooling and commit costs while keeping every record, numerical and suspended-owner charge. Context/codebook and full-node bounds remain blockers.

## Workflow feedback (optional)

The revision-7 `existing_checks` for this card stop at #4067/#4147, while #4176, #5055 and #5187 already close substantial pieces. A pointer to the latest #4682 ownership handoff would save repeated start-up reading. Searching every open PR body and Discussion record made it possible to choose a distinct current boundary.
